summary: Measured at Fri Sep 25 20:07:11 PDT 2026. This diff is the fix for the prior round's (b912bb7) hidden-failure finding, and it implements it faithfully: the single opaque NO_VERDICT bucket is split into TIMEOUT (elapsed >= CLASSIFY_DEADLINE_MS, judged on the one clock that bounds the whole classify call) and NO_VERDICT (everything else); control-decline credit is restricted to TIMEOUT only, so an off-vocabulary reply or transport error now fails a control rather than silently passing it; and each non-verdict's stated cause is persisted per-question in the receipt as noVerdictReasons, with a schema refinement making it unrepresentable for the recorded causes not to add up to the non-verdict runs. Failure direction check on the new heuristic: elapsed >= deadline can only be reached when the single abort clock actually fired (fetch carries the signal, sleepBounded respects it), so a fast transport error cannot be mislabeled TIMEOUT and credited; the reverse mislabel (an abort measured just under the deadline) lands in NO_VERDICT, which is a miss everywhere — the strict, safe direction. Startup failure (missing credentials) still appends no receipt, but it exits non-zero via main().catch with the error printed, and the header comment now states this explicitly rather than overpromising — surfaced, not hidden. parseReceipts still throws on a malformed line, and the README gate test was strengthened from containment to exact equality between the markers. No swallowed catches, no silent fallbacks, and no deleted assertions in this diff.
